message: No detected untrusted source handling: No checksum verification, pinned revisions, signed URLs, or authentication is performed when loading pretrained models or remote data sources.

No detected label flipping detection: The code only maps string labels to vocabulary indices (Vocabulary class in TaskDefs) without any distribution comparison, expected-set validation, or label-noise detection tool.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs is present anywhere in the visible data-preparation code path.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models via the transformers library (e.g., BertModel, RobertaModel) and custom classes without any hash verification, signature check, or pinned revision to ensure integrity of the loaded weights.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense in the training loop.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or robustness stress tests are referenced or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of hashed/signed evaluation data, strict train/test isolation enforcement, or use of multiple independent metrics as a cross-check against manipulation in the visible evaluation code.

No detected input sanitization: The inference path (eval_model, extract_encoding) passes batch data directly to the model after a simple CUDA patch without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No NaN guards, probability bounds checks, or threshold validation are visible in the inference code; outputs are collected and returned without sanity checks.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although some T5/seq2seq models are included, there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection implemented anywhere in the visible inference path.
